description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for git filter configurations, handling of large files, and line ending conversions. It uses test-lib.sh for utility functions and verifies behaviors related to git attributes, filters, and large file processing.

methods.name: set_attr
methods.description: Sets git attributes for files by creating or overwriting .gitattributes with specified attributes.

methods.name: check_input
methods.description: Verifies the correct application of input filters by comparing file contents before and after applying filters.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Verifies the correct application of output filters by comparing original and filtered files.
